A points failure has been reported, and this is preventing trains from using some of the routes through this area.
Points are moveable sections of track that guide trains from one route to another at junctions. If they develop a fault, for example because something is obstructing the moving parts or there is a problem with the electronic control system, they may not move into the correct position. Staff may sometimes need access to the track while the fault is investigated or repaired. Trains may need to be stopped for a short time while this happens, which means your train could be held at a station or signal even if its usual route through the area remains available.
